Commentary.Commentary: So that's it from all of us here. The result does not surprise anyone honestly. Zimbabwe will be happy with the progress shown in the series. They competed better and had their moments too but Sri Lanka and especially Rangana Herath was too good for them. Hope you enjoyed our coverage. Do join us for all the action coming ahead. Till then, you can switch tabs and catch up on the updates from the first Test between India and England. Cheers!

Man of the Match, Sri Lanka skipper RANGANA HERATH begins by saying that he is looking to improve every single day. On being the oldest player to take 350 Test wickets, he says that he has not decided on how long he will continue playing so will take it match by match.

Man of the series DIMUTH KARUNARATNE starts off by saying that he was struggling against Australia but he got a good score and it helped him build confidence. Calls it a good wicket to bat and he was happy to occupy the crease and play the whole day. Jokes that he hopes to get a place in the ODI side for the coming Tri-series.

Zimbabwe skipper, GRAEME CREMER says he feels there are a lot of positives for his side. Credits Sri Lanka for the way they played. Adds that they had prepared well for this game and despite the loss, have a lot of positives to take. Says he thinks his side are a shorter format team and are not yet ready for the longer format, so will try their absolute best to change that.

From the first day itself Sri Lanka were in the driver's seat. They set a huge total in front of the hosts on the back of centuries from de Silva and Gunaratne and ensured they didn't have a chance to make their way from there. The Rhodesians fought hard and put up a gritty fight, but were undone by a brilliant collective bowling display. Same thing followed as the home side faced a monstrous task to chase down a massive target and it proved to be too much for them.

So, as expected, Sri Lanka have won this match and that too in the early hours of the final day. They only needed 3 wickets to win this match along with the series, and they've done so rather comfortably. We've already given him plenty of mentions but it still doesn't seem enough. The Lankan skipper and their star, Rangana Herath, is once again the man to lead from the front. He's taken 13 wickets in the entire game, scalping 8 in this innings. What a player!

OUT! ALL OVER! SRI LANKA WIN BY 257 RUNS! Floated on middle, Mpofu comes forward to defend but he is playing down the wrong line and is hit on his pads. The players appeal and the umpire upholds it. Mpofu wants to review but he does not have any left to do so. That is it, HERATH TAKES 8/63 and SRI LANKA WIN THE SERIES 2-0!
Outside off, Mpofu is not temped and is happy to defend this.
Floated on middle, Mpofu keeps it out.
Outside off, Mpofu gets across and paddles it down to fine leg for a couple.
Floated on middle, defended off the inside edge through square leg for a single.
Flatter on the pads, tucked down to fine leg for a couple of runs.
SIX! And another one! Perera gives this one air on middle, Mpofu gets under it and swings it over mid-wicket for another maximum.
Flatter one on the stumps, Mpofu defends it back.
Drives it through mid off for a single.
Comes forward and blocks this one out.
A touch short outside off, puched off the back foot by Tiripano to deep point. The fielder gives it a chase and keeps them to a couple.
Bowls it on off, comes in, kept out back down the wicket.
Floated on middle, Mpofu comes forward and defends it back in time.
Heaves it through mid-wicket for a run.
Outside off, Tiripano defends it.
Winds up for a big shot but drives it down to long on for a single.
SIX! HO, HO, HO! Landed on off and middle, Mpofu gets under it and swings it over mid-wicket for a maximum. He then points something to the dressing room. That was some shot from him!
Floated outside off, Mpofu comes forward and defends it just short of silly point.
Goes back and works it through square leg for a single.
Floated on middle, Mpofu comes forward and defends it back. He then shadow practices playing a lofted drive.
Another reverse sweep through third man for a single.
Stays back and punches it to covers.
Plays a nice little sweep towards the on side.
FOUR! REVERSE SWEEP! Tiripano picks this one early and reverse sweeps it through backward point for a boundary.
Floated on middle, Mpofu goes for the sweep but gets a top edge that falls away from the fielder chasing it from square leg. They take a couple.
A touch quicker one on middle, kept out by Mpofu.
An action replay of the previous delivery.
Mpofu comes forward and defends it in the air towards silly point.
This one keeps low but Mpofu does well to get it through square leg for a couple.
CHRISTOPHER MPOFU is the last man in.

OUT! HERATH HAS ANOTHER ONE! Flatter on middle, Mumba looks to defend but is hit on his front pad and the ball goes off the edge to first slip where de Silva takes the catch. He played down the wrong line there. The players appeal and the umpire raises his finger. That is given out lbw since the ball hit the front pad first. That is seven for Herath!
Good length on middle, worked to square leg for a single by Mumba to get off the mark.
On a length on middle, Mumba clips it towards mid-wicket off his crease.
Attempts the yorker and gets it right this time but Mumba knows it is coming and keeps it out.
On a length on middle, tucked down to fine leg for a single by Tiripano. Leg bye is signaled.
Dishes out a full toss on off, Tiripano creams his drive towards mid off.

FOUR! Take that! Lakmal looks for reverse but dishes out a half-volley on off. Tiripano presents the full face of the bat and hits it down towards long on. Herath slides from mid on but cannot stop it, it was timed too well.
Landed on middle, Mumba defends it with an inside edge towards the on side.
Bowls the carrom ball on middle, Mumba blocks it well.
Comes forward and keeps this one out.
Flatter on middle, Mumba looks to defend but the ball pops out towards short leg off the pads. Mild appeal turned down.
Fuller outside off, Mumba defends it.
CARL MUMBA is the new man in.

OUT! WHAT A CATCH, DE SILVA! Floated well outside off, Ervine looks to sweep but does not connect well. de Silva goes to his left at first but then spots the edge going to his right and he recovers in time to take the catch with both hands. The players celebrate but Ervine thinks that he has not hit it and points towards his arm to Donald Tiripano. The replays show that it is touch and go, it did hit the arm but also seemed to have brushed the glove. There is not enough evidence to over-rule the on-field call and it stays out and that is a big wicket for Sri Lanka. One wonders if Ervine needed to attempt such a shot. Anyway, he has to go, he is not happy but Sri Lanka inch closer to a victory. They are just two wickets away! That is also five for Herath, his 27th five-wicket haul in Tests!
What a catch from de Silva but hang on, Ervine thinks he has not hit it and reviews it.
Goes over the wicket to the right-hander, bowls it on off, Tiripano gets in line and defends it.
Bowls it on middle, seems to be going down, Ervine looks to clip and gets it towards mid-wicket. They cross for a single as the players appeal but there was an edge there.
Shorter length outside off, Ervin thinks to go for the pull at first but then does not play the shot.
Fuller outside off, Ervine comes forward and drives it towards mid off.
FOUR BYES! Tries to bowl another yorker but slips it down the leg side, Ervine cannot clip it. The keeper dives to his right but cannot stop it from going to the fine leg fence. Byes signaled.
Bowls the yorker on off, Ervine brins his bat down in time and keeps it out.
Comes forward and defends this one nicely.
REVERSE SWEEP? Landed outside leg, Tiripano looks to reverse sweep this but fails to connect. Not sure if he needs to attempt these.
Tossed up on middle, Tiripano comes forward and blocks it.
Floated on middle, Tiripano clips it towards mid-wicket.
Tossed up outside leg, Tiripano comes forward and keeps it out.
Floated on off, Tiripano comes forward and defends it.
Goes over the wicket.
Angled on a fuller length at 130 kph, Ervine comes forward and defends it.
BEATEN! Hurls it outside off on a length from wide of the crease, Ervine has to play at it and he does but fails to connect. That was nicely bowled.
Good length outside off, Ervine punches it towards covers off his crease.
Fuller length outside off, Ervine lets it go through.
Another wide half-volley from Lakmal, Ervine drives it towards covers where the short cover dives and stops the ball.
FOUR! BEAUTIFUL! Bowls it from wide of the crease but bowls it outside off, asking to be driven, Ervine comes forward and drives it through extra cover for a boundary. That was superbly timed!
Floated on middle, Tiripano comes forward and defends it off the inner half towards short leg.
Outside off, fuller length, Tiripano comes forward and blocks it.
Bowls the slider on middle, worked towards square leg by Tiripano.
Floated outside off, Tiripano comes forward and defends it past silly point.
Shorter one on off, Tiripano stays back and punches it back down the wicket.
Floated outside off, turns in and keeps low as well, Ervine does well to play it with the turn through backward square leg for a single.
On a length again on off, Tiripano defends it. The short leg fielder collects the ball on the rebound and still puts up an appeal.
On a good length outside off, Tiripano feels for it, hangs his bat out for it but is beaten.
Angles it on a fuller length on middle, Tiripano comes forward and keeps it out.

Bowls it on a length on middle, coming in, Tiripano looks to defend but is rapped on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire says no. That looked like going down leg and replays also spot an edge. Good call.

FOUR BYES! On a length outside off, does not get up at all. Tiripano lets it go through as the ball just shaves past the off stump. The keeper cannot stop it due to the bad bounce and it runs down to the fence. Byes signaled.
Bowls it from around the wicket, sliding on the pads, Ervine tucks it down to fine leg for a single. He gets going with a run. He has given strike to Tiripano though early in the over.
SURANGA LAKMAL to bowl from the other end.
A touch flat and on the pads, Tiripano goes back and defends it towards short leg.
Floated outside off, another solid defense from Tiripano.
Outside off, the slider, Tiripano is forward to it and blocks it.
Floated on middle, Tiripano comes right forward and keeps it out.
Tiripano comes forward and defends it solidly.
Starts off with one on middle, Tiripano comes forward and defends it.

Game time! The players are out in the middle. Sri Lanka need 3 more wickets, Zimbabwe need 311 more runs. That though seems unlikely for now. CRAIG ERVINE and DONALD TIRIPANO to bat for Zimbabwe. Sri Lanka begin with RANGANA HERATH! Here we go...

Hello everyone and welcome to the coverage of the final day of the second Test between Sri Lanka and Zimbabwe. The visitors are sitting on the cusp of a series win needing only three more wickets to win. How long Zimbabwe fight on remains to be seen. They have Craig Ervine batting for them and the hosts will hope that he can stitch a stand and try and take the game deep. Let's see how the Sri Lankans go about the final day's play.
DAY 5... FIRST SESSION....

Amidst all this, it is important not to forget the fight shown by the southpaw Craig Ervine who is still unbeaten at the moment on 65. Sean Williams played his part as well but just couldn't deal with the mighty Lankans. So, it's time to say it legally that the writing is on the wall for the Rhodesians as they need to battle it out for the full day tomorrow and have just 3 wickets left. We should be in for an early wrap up on the final day. Join us back at 1330 IST to see how long will SL take to seal the series 2-0. Until then, goodnight and take care. Cheers!

Sri Lanka declared after playing for an hour after lunch setting a mammoth target of 491 in front of the home side. Once the chase resumed, Zimbabwe never looked like they can draw this as the veteran, the tormentor-in-chief, the deadly left-arm orthodox, call him whatever you want, Rangana Herath, spun the web magnificently to register yet another 5-fer under his belt as he ran through the hosts' batting line-up. He was well supported by his fellow mates as they grabbed catches at will to never let the momentum dent.

What a day for Sri Lanka yet again! This was their Test the moment they kicked off on day 1. They never let the momentum slip and always kept a firm hold on it and look now, they are just 3 wickets away from sealing the series. The day started with Sri Lanka having Karunaratne and Gunaratne at the crease. The former missed out on a deserving ton but then down the order Kusal Perera made sure that the target would be out of the reach for the hosts.
Full ball outside off, Ervine drives this away. Hits it hard but it's straight to the cover fielder. THAT WILL BE STUMPS ON DAY 4!
Bowls this slower through the air and it's outside off, left alone by Craig Ervine.
Dilruwan Perera pitches this one right up there, just around off, it's driven to mid off for no run.
Floated on off, pushed to the off side.
Four Byes! Dilruwan tossed up an off breaker around off, it keeps low and turns as well. Beats the outside edge, goes between the keeper's legs and away to the fence behind for a boundary.
From around the wicket, tossed up around off, defended on the off side.
The batsman has offered no stroke to an incoming delivery.
Another one which is tossed up and it's attacking the stumps once more, defended gently on the on side.
Floated one around off, Donald drops it in front of silly point.
Full and attacking the stumps, Tiripano fortunately bumps it to the fielder at short leg.
Donald Tiripano walks into the middle next to bat.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! Rangi is right on the money once more. Bowls an arm ball once more and it's dipping and swerving here. Goes right between bat and pad as Cremer leans forward to block. The bails are knocked off and that's the end of the Rhodesian skipper. Sri Lanka just need 3 more wickets to win this match.

Around the wicket, Herath bowls an arm ball and it's coming in with the angle on middle and off. There's a loud shout for a caught behind but there was no bat involved as Cremer tried to play at it. Only went off the pad behind to first slip.
Full outside off, Cremer opens his body up a bit and dabs it past backward point to retain strike.
Pitched on a length on off stump, Graeme Cremer stays deep within his crease and keeps it out.
Dilruwan extracts a bit of extra bounce there, on middle and off, hits the batsman on the body as he goes back to play at it.
Over the wicket now to Cremer, it's a flatter one around off, fullish in length as well, defended stoutly.
Full and flat around off, it goes off the outside edge and runs down towards short third man as the batsmen take a single.
Starts things off from around the wicket and flights it around off, Ervine taps it in front of the vacant silly point region.
Dilruwan Perera is back on.
From around the wicket for the last ball of the over, Rangi floats it up on middle and off, there's some dip on that as well. It's kept out solidly off the front foot.
Ervine plays with the spin and turns it past short leg to pick up a run.
Full and loopy on the stumps, the left-hander prods forward and defends it with a straight blade.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Ervine gets low to this one and sweeps it away on the leg side.
Over the wicket to start things off with, it's short and flat around off, Craig goes back and works it on the on side.
Short and going well down leg, Graeme has nothing to do with that. Ducks and leaves it alone for Kusal Perera to collect.
Back of a length ball outside off, Craig punches it towards cover-point and runs to the other end to complete a single.

That's a good shot by Graeme Cremer. It's a full ball on middle and leg, the Zimbabwe captain wrists it between mid-wicket and mid on. The fielder from mid-wicket chases it down and save the boundary. Keeps the batsmen to three runs.
Lakmal bangs in a short of a length delivery and gets it to angle in to Craig Ervine, the southpaw pulls it along the ground to the fielder at mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller length ball on middle and leg, Cremer makes use of his wrists and works it towards wide mid on for a single.
From around the wicket, back of a length around off, Ervine rides the bounce and pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Graeme Cremer, the Zimbabwean skipper is the next batsman in.

OUT! Herath strikes again! What a catch! Boy, these Sri Lankans are electric on the field today, they have taken everything that has come their way. Tossed up ball around off, turns away a bit after pitching. Moor gets back to defend but ends up playing it a bit uppishly towards silly point where Kusal Mendis takes a sharp catch. This is also Herath's 50th Test wicket in the calendar year. SL need 4 wickets to win!
Gives this one a bit more flight as Moor pushes it towards short extra cover for nothing.
Tossed up on the stumps, PM bunts it back to Herath.
Full and angling in, Moor comes forward, keeps his bat close to pad and defends.
Makes a good stride forward and defends it down the ground.
Comes down the track and flicks it past a diving short mid-wicket fielder for a couple.
Back of a length delivery on off, defended on the off side.
Replica of the last delivery the only difference is, they didn't appeal this time.

Short and going down leg, Peter Joseph Moor still feels for it as he tries to pull it on its way. Fails to get any wood on it as K. Perera moves swiftly to his left to collect. He appeals for a catch but it's not given.
Angles in a length ball on off, Ervine taps it towards covers for a single.
Strays on the pads once more as Peter flicks it towards fine leg for a single. 50-run stand comes up as well.
Fuller and on the pads, Moor flicks it uppishly towards mid-wicket for an easy double.
Suranga Lakmal is brought back into the attack.
FOUR! Reverse swept! Full and outside off, Ervine gets down, brings out the reverse sweep and places it behind point for a boundary to end the over.
Gets back and offers a straight bat.
Full and around off, blocked out gently.
Comes in with the angle on off, Ervine gets back and punches it back to the bowler.
An arm ball around off, Craig gets across and sweeps it towards short fine leg. That's a risky stroke to play, if you miss you are rapped on the pads.
Full and around off, Ervine gets down and across and paddles it towards the leg side.
Short of a length delivery on off, Moor arches back and lets it go.
In the channel outside off, it's left alone.
Lucky! Angles in a length delivery on off, Moor looks to pull it across the line but gets an inside edge that falls just short of the keeper who dives to his left to take it.
Back of a length ball outside off, Moor gets on top of the bounce and cuts it through point for a brace.
Fuller and angling in, Moor defends it off the front foot gently.
Short of a length delivery outside off, Ervine cuts it through cover-point for a single.

Not out! That was a very close one. Herath comes from around the wicket and bowls an arm ball around off, Moor presses forward in an attempt to block. He misses and is caught on the front pad. The umpire is unmoved as the Lankans appeal loudly for a leg before. Herath is convinced that he has got his man and so, decides to review the decision. It goes upstairs and replays show that the impact was outside the line of off stump. So the decision stays. It was pretty close, can't fault the Sri Lankan skipper for taking the review.
PJ Moor is caught leg before but is adjudged not out. So Herath takes a review against the decision.
Full around off, pushed straight to short cover.
Around the wicket to Moor, Herath bowls a slider on middle and off, blocked.
Flatter and slightly shorter around off, CE gets back and works it through mid-wicket for one.
Outside off, Craig gets to the pitch and pushes it back to the bowler.
Floated around off, pushed to covers for a single.
3rd Test fifty for Craig Ervine!

FOUR! Two in two for the southpaw! What a way to bring up his fifty. Back of a length delivery around off, Ervine picks up he length early, rocks back and pulls it hard through mid-wicket to send it all the way.
FOUR! Poor line from Lahiru. Angles it down leg, Ervine just glances this towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Short of a length once more, hit on the off side for nothing.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Ervine punches it off the back foot but it's straight to the man at covers.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Craig looks to put bat on ball but fails to do so.
Continues from around the wicket, a length ball outside off, left alone by Craig for the keeper to collect.
FOUR! Rangi floats this one up on the stumps, Moor once again waits for it and hammers it over the bowler's head to pick up another boundary. Great way to end the over.
Flighted on the stumps, blocked.

FOUR! Herath gives this a lot of air and tosses it up on the stumps, Moor waits for the ball to land, clears his front leg and smashes it past the diving mid off fielder to send it to the boundary line.
Over the wicket now to the left-hander, Ervine gets low and sweeps this fine on the leg side as he takes it on the full. One run taken.
From around the wicket this time, it's looped up on the stumps, Moor eases it past a diving Rangana Herath to pick up a single.
Tossed up on middle and off, CE skips down the track and drives it to long on for a single.
Rangana Herath is back on.
Lahiru keeps it on the shorter side and angles it in to the southpaw, it's pulled through to deep square leg for one run.
Swing and a miss! Short of a length delivery outside off, Ervine once again goes for the big pull shot. Misses it completely as the ball goes under the bat.

FOUR! There was a bit of glove on that. Just about eluded the keeper. Bangs it in short and going down leg, Erive gets it off the glove as he tries to pull it away. It goes past Kusal Perera who dives full stretch to his right in an attempt to take it. Races away to the fence for a boundary.
Kumara spears in a full ball on the stumps, Craig stays deep within his crease and wrists it to mid on.
Short of a length delivery outside off, Ervine goes for the big booming pull over mid-wicket but ends up getting a bottom edge behind towards the keeper.
Length ball angling in from around off, it's kept out off the back foot. Gently tapped in front of covers.
FOUR! Should give PJ a bit of confidence, that. Full on the pads, it's whipped through backward square leg for a boundary.
The batsman drives the ball straight down the ground.
On a flatter trajectory once more, it's dipping and swerving on middle and off, pushed back in the direction of the bowler.
Some flight on this occasion, Moor comes forward to block.
Around off, driven to covers for nothing.
Continues from around the wicket, bowls a flatter one on the stump, it's hit back down the track.
Short and down the leg side, Ervine gets inside the line and lets it go.
Fuller in length and around off, Ervine digs it out on the off side.

SIX! What was that, Craig? A six off a top edge, ridiculous! Short of a length delivery, angling on leg. Ervine rolls his wrists, swivels to help it on its way. Gets it off the top edge and goes flat over the fielder stationed at fine leg for a biggie.
On a length and angling in, Craig gets behind the line and defends it with a straight bat.
Back of a length ball outside off, punched off the back foot towards covers.
Fuller on the stumps, jammed towards mid on.
Loopy ball outside off. Ervine comes forward and drives it towards mid off. The fielder moves to his right and parries it to long off. The batsmen take three. End of a successful over.
On middle and off, driven towards mid on for a single.
PJ Moor walks into the middle next.

OUT! That's gone! de Silva bowls a flatter ball around off, scoots through the surface. Waller comes forward to defend but misses and K. Perera behind the stumps collects it. The Lankans go up in an appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Dhananjaya was very confident and convinces his skipper to take the review. Replays show there was some noise but to be honest it wasn't that conclusive enough. However, the TV umpire feels it the other way. He heard some noise as the ball goes through to the keeper. The on-field call has to be overturned and Zimbabwe now have lost half their side.
A caught behind appeal against Waller is taken upstairs. The on-field umpire wasn't to keen but de Silva, the bolwer was very confident. Let's see if Waller has edged it or not.
Loopy ball around off, pushed through covers for a single.
Very full around middle, defended down watchfully.
Tossed up ball around off, Ervine plunges forward in defense.
Malcolm Waller is the new man in!
Drinks time at Harare!

OUT! Kumara strikes! This is the wicket they wanted as Williams was looking good out there. Hurls it on a length outside off, some bounce off the deck as Williams pokes at it timidly. An outside edge is induced and Mendis at first slip takes a sharp catch bending forward. Lahiru Kumara is absolutely pumped up as he breaks the 74-run stand.
On a length and outside off, Sean covers the line and defends it towards covers.
Fuller in length on off, pushed towards the man at mid on.
Back of a length delivery on off, blocked off the front foot.

Three wides! Short and going down leg, Williams has got nothing to do with that one. Poor Perera dives to his right but the ball goes off his gloves and races down to fine leg where the fielder cuts it off. Two runs picked up.
Arrows in a full ball on off, Williams looks to defend but gets an inside edge on the pads.
Back of a length delivery on middle, Williams swivels and pulls it in front of square for a couple.
CE has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
A shout for lbw! Full and around off, Craig looks to defend it off the front foot but gets a thick inside edge on the pads. An appeal is made but the umpire spots the inside edge.
Looped up on off, Craig is solid in his defense.
Loopy delivery around middle and off, Ervine prods forward and defends.
Gets behind the line and defends it down.
Tossed up ball around off, driven towards mid off for a single.
Dhananjaya de Silva is brought into the attack.

Top edge and it's dropped! Lahiru bangs it in short on middle and leg, Williams looks to pull but gets a top edge that flies towards fine leg. The substitute fielder Sandakan misjudges the ball as it bursts off his palms and falls down. This could have been a big wicket. A single is taken.
Angles in a full ball on off, Williams defends this one away from his body.
On a length and outside off, punched off the back foot towards covers.
Angles in a length ball on the pads, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, defended gently towards covers.
Back of a length delivery on off, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
Full on the stumps, dipping in once more, Williams wrists it down to long on for a single to end the over.
Full outside off, it's pushed gently a bit square on the off side.
Dipping in from around off, Sean defends it into the track.
Much better from the spinner, tosses it up on middle and off, it's eased down to long on for a run.
FOUR! Same ball, same shot. It's swept fine down the leg side for back-to-back boundaries. Dilruwan needs to do better here.
FOUR! Sliding down the leg side, Ervine just sweeps this fine down the leg side. It in face went off the glove but it won't matter either way. Craig will get a boundary to his name.
Short of a length ball outside off, dabbed in front of covers off the back foot for no run. That'll be the end of the over.
Extremely full from Lahiru Kumara, however it's too straight. It's angling in on middle and leg, clipped through the square leg region for a run.
Back of a length delivery around off, Craig Ervine goes for the big pull over mid-wicket but fails to make any connection.
That's a very good delivery! Length ball outside off, Ervine is beaten as the ball goes past the outside edge. The southpaw looked to have a poke at it but missed.
Angles in a length delivery from around off, on middle and off, it's tucked down through backward square leg for a single.
From around the wicket, Kumara with a back of a length delivery outside off, Williams hangs back and taps it on the off side. No run taken.
Covers the line and defends it with a straight bat.
Around middle and off, Ervine gets back and pushes it from the crease towards point.
Sean this time pushes it through covers for a single.
50-run stand between Ervine and Williams!

SIX! Go fetch it, if you can! This is certainly a meaty blow! Tossed up ball around middle and off, Williams sits down on one knee and nails the slog sweep to perfection towards deep mid-wicket. Sends it flat into the stands for a biggie all the way. You got to admire this shot!
Loopy ball around middle and leg, Craig gets down and sweeps it towards backward square leg for a single.
Tossed up ball around middle and off, Ervine digs it out.
Almost dragged that on! Length delivery aiming the top of off stump, Ervine looks to tap it away but gets an inside edge just past the leg stump. Close call there. A single is taken to end the over.
Comes from around the wicket now and pounds in a back of a length delivery, it's outside off as Williams punches it in front of covers. Runs to the other end quickly and completes the run.
Fuller ball on the stumps, it goes off the inside half towards square as the batsmen take a single.
Lahiru brings out the short one and bangs it in hard outside off, Craig leans back and lets it sail over it.

FOUR! He really got a hold of that, didn't he? Back of a length delivery around off, it didn't bounce much and that allowed Ervine to latch on it in a flash. He rocks back and muscles the pull through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Short of a length delivery angling way across, the batsman doesn't bother himself with that.
Beauty of a delivery! This one bites off the surface as Williams prods forward to defend but is beaten completely. Replays show it just whizzed past the outside edge.
Drifting around off, turning away as well. Williams tries to defend it from the crease but gets an outside edge which falls wide of de Silva at first slip.
FOUR! Shot! Gets it this time. Sees the flight, Williams wears his skates, meets the pitch and tonks it over Perera's head for a boundary.
Flatter one around middle and off, Sean hangs back and defends.

Loopy ball around off, Williams comes down track and tries to hit it down the ground. Isn't quite to the pitch of the ball and hence miscues it towards long off. The mid off fielder was inside the circle who gives it a chase and keeps them down to a couple.

A shout for lbw, but seemed to be going down leg. Perera bowls a slider around middle, skidding through the surface as Williams is late to bring his bat down and is rapped on the back pad. An appeal is made but the umpire shakes his head.
Dilruwan Perera replaces Herath now...
Four Leg Byes! On the hips, CE looks to glance it away but it goes off his thigh pad. Races away to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
A length delivery which keeps a little low, skids off the surface a bit, Craig Ervine walks across and manages to keeps it out.
Just back of a length on the stumps, it's worked towards mid-wicket for a brisk run.
Short of a length ball on the body, Craig doesn't exactly middle it but it's enough as the ball goes towards square leg. One run taken.
Shortish delivery just outside off, Ervine at the last second drops his wrists and lets the ball through to the keeper.
Poor line to start things off with. Kumara should feel lucky that hasn't crossed the boundary line. Straying on the hips, it's pulled away down to fine leg for a single.
Lahiru Kumara comes into the attack now.
Floated ball around off, Ervine digs it out.
Comes down the track and pushes it towards mid off for a brisk single.
Flattish ball on off, Sean makes a brave leave.
Full and fired on the stumps, bunted back towards the bowler who moves to his left while the fielder at short mid-wicket comes to his right. Both of them put a dive and luckily they didn't collide.
Tossed up around middle and leg, Ervine paddles it towards short fine leg for a single.
A shout for lbw! Bowls a quicker ball around leg, Ervine looks to sweep but misses and is hit on the pads. An appeal is made but the umpire is unmoved. Maybe, it pitched outside leg.
Another short one by Lakmal to end the over. This one though is angling way down the leg side, Sean initially thinks about pulling it away but then decides against it.
Lakmal brings out the short one and pounds it in hard on off, Sean Williams picks up the length early and does well to duck under it.
Length delivery outside off, Sean gracefully shoulders his arms to that one.

Almost! Lakmal bowls a fuller length delivery around off and gets it to angle in to the left-hander, Williams looks to push it through the covers but gets an inside edge which just whiskers past the leg pole. Two runs are taken as the ball rolls away towards fine leg.
Just ahead of a length, outside off, pushed to covers for nothing.
FOUR! Lovely timing. Full and pitched outside off, Williams plants his front foot across and drives it crisply through the covers to get a boundary to his name.
Beaten! An arm ball around off, skidding through the surface. Ervine looks to cut but is beaten all ends up.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

What an effort in the deep by Karunaratne! Herath bowls it slower through the air around middle, Ervine gets down and sweeps it through backward square leg. Dimuth comes sprinting to his left, puts in a dive and stops it with his left hand. Keeps the pair down to a couple and Herath is applauding for the effort.
Loopy ball around middle and off, CE buries it into the ground.
Outside off, coming in, Ervine tries to sweep this one from outside off but misses and is hit on the pads.
Tossed up ball around off, pushed down to long on for a single.
Superb stop! Length delivery, it's a touch short as well outside off. Ervine looks to cut it through point but a brillinat dive to the right by the fielder denies him a boundary.
Good cricket at the moment! Angles in a length ball on middle, Williams works it nicely through mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! If the previous one was an edgy one, this is much better. Good length ball outside off, Sean Williams doesn't try to hit it hard, just uses the pace, opens the face of the bat and glides it through backward point for another boundary.

FOUR! Flashes and it goes over first slip! Lakmal hits the deck hard and gets the bounce on it. Williams goes for the flash through the off side but gets an outside edge which goes over a leaping first slip fielder for a boundary. Lakmal is bowling really well and has a lot of venom, it's very visible.
On a length and angling in as well. Williams gets behind the line and defends it towards covers.
Fuller in length on off, Williams is rock solid in defense as he keeps it out on the off side.

That was a close call! Could have been out on two counts! Loopy on middle and off, Craig Ervine dances down the track and looks to flick it across the line. He gets an inside edge onto the pads and the ball falls short of the diving silly point fielder. There's still a chance of a run out though but the fielder is unable to gather the ball in time. Early reprieve for Craig.
Keeps low again. Outside off, defended from within the crease.
This one doesn't spin as much and keeps a bit low as well. It's on a flatter trajectory as Williams get back to punch it out past silly point. Gets a single for doing so.
FLighted delivery on middle and off, Sean presses ahead and dead-bats it into the track.
Turning in from around off, worked in front of short leg.

FOUR! That's such a confident looking shot. Beautifully played, beautifully played. Herath tosses it up nicely outside off, Williams uses his feet, gets to the pitch of the delivery and just pushes it through the covers to pick up a boundary.
Keeps it a bit on a fuller side this time, just outside the off stump, tapped gently to the off side to end the over.
Keeps it on a length here, Suranga Lakmal, in that channel outside off, once again it's left alone.
Fuller length ball coming in from around off, Ervine leans forward and buries it into the track ahead.
Fuller ball on off, it's driven hard but straight to the fielder at mid off.

Lakmal comes charging in and angles in a length delivery from outside off, he's really bending his back here and getting some good carry once more. Craig Ervine however has nothing to do with this delivery and lets it be.
Length ball outside off, kept out off the back foot.
Sean Williams is the next batsman in!

OUT! Edged and it's taken! That's a superb catch by Dhananjaya de Silva, mind blowing! Herath gives this one loads of flight and hurls it around off, Tino Mawoyo presses forward to defend but the ball turns away, takes the outside edge and flies towards first slip where de Silva is very alert. He bends forward and low and grabs it just inches above the ground. He was confident the moment he took that. The umpire still refers it upstairs and replays show that's cleanly taken. A 3-fer already for the Lankan skipper and he is leading from the front again. Zimbabwe slip further.
Tino Mawoyo has edged one and a catch has been taken behind at first slip. The umpire goes upstairs to check whether it was taken cleanly or not. The soft signal is out.
Tossed up delivery around off, driven towards short extra cover.
Gives this one a bit more flight and bowls it full around off, Mawoyo looks to flick but gets a leading edge towards covers.
On middle and off, bunted back to Rangi.
Loopy ball around off, Tino comes forward and defends it down gently.
Flatter ball around middle, worked off the back foot towards the leg side.
FOUR! Length ball well outside off, it's run down to third man for a boundary. Easily done by the southpaw.
Length delivery outside off, no shot offered on that occasion.

Stifled appeal for a leg before but that was never going to be given out. Height was always the issue. Shaping in heavily from outside off, Craig Ervine is caught high on the thigh pad as he tries to play at it.

Lakmal has a change of angle and comes from around the wicket, bowls a slightly fuller length ball outside off, Ervine plants his front foot forward and looks to drive it through the covers but fails to make any connection.
Angles a length delivery across the left-hander, left alone for the keeper to collect.
Pitched fractionally ahead of a length just around the off stump, it's defended solidly.
Suranga Lakmal to bowl from the other end!
Flatter and straighter on middle and off, Tino Mawoyo gets right behind the line and keeps it out.
Ervine comes down the track and eases it down to long on for a single.
Around off, Ervine gets an inside edge onto this pads as he tries to play at it.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Close one. Herath tosses it up on middle and leg, Tino flicks it towards short leg. It goes off the boot of the fielder there and falls safely before he can pouch it. Close call.
Slider on middle and leg, it's swept towards square leg for no run.
We are back for the final session of the day. Craig Ervine and Tino Mawoyo will continue with the bat. Rangana Herath will take the ball first up...
... DAY 4, SESSION 3 ...

The writing is on the wall for Zimbabwe and they are going to need a miracle if they are to even get a draw out of this. A lot rests on Craig Ervine and the experienced middle order and it will be intriguing to see how the last session pans out. Stay tuned as it will begin in a short while.

Tea will surely taste good for Sri Lanka as they are closing in on a victory here. After setting a target of 491, they came out and bowled insidiously. They have managed to take out 2 Zimbabwean wickets already and are looking more and more dangerous as play progresses. Last innings hero Brian Chari and Hamilton Masakadza have been sent back in quick succession.
Loopy ball around middle and off, Ervine makes a long stride forward and keeps it out on the off side. THAT'S TEA ON DAY 4!
Floats it up around off, Ervine presses forward and defends it down gently.
Angles it on middle and leg, gets across and defends it.
Loopy ball around off, Craig gest forward and pushes it towards covers.
Fired full on the stumps, Ervin blocks it out watchfully.
Starts with a loopy ball around off, turing in as well. Mawoyo gets back and flicks it through square leg for a single.
Dilruwan Perera is introduced into the attack! Should be the last over before Tea.
Craig Ervine is the next man in to bat.

OUT! Herath has another! He bowls a tossed up delivery around middle, scoots through the surface as Masakadza is a tad late to defend it by coming forward. Misses the line and is rapped on the pads right in front of the stumps. A loud appeal goes up and the umpire raises his dread finger. Hamilton takes the review and replays show it was in line and would have gone on to clip the leg stump. So, the umpire's call stays. Zimbabwe rocked early in the run chase, SL need 8 more wickets to win.
Hamilton Masakadza has been caught leg before. He isn't convinced though and has decided to take a review against the decision.
Around off, Masakadza drives it on the up but straight to short extra cover.
Loopy around middle and leg, HM gets down and paddles it down to fine leg for a couple.
Floated ball around off, Hamilton defends it down watchfully.
Makes a long stride forward and keeps it out.
FOUR! Angles in an arm ball around off, Masakadza gets back quickly and punches it on the up through covers. Once it pierced the gap it was always going for a boundary.
FOUR! Full outside off, it's driven back down the ground for a boundary. Beautiful shot, played it with the full face of the bat.
Leg bye! The batsman has been struck on the thigh pad. One run added to the total. Leg byes given by the umpire.

Just missed! That was close. No need to even play at that, really. Length ball shaping away outside off, Hamilton Masakadza leans forward to poke at it but is beaten as the ball goes past the outside edge.

A bit of extra bounce there. Well, well... On an excellent length outside off, Hamilton is a bit tentative as he decides to back out of the shot at the last minute. Is lucky that is falls just in front of the diving gully fielder.
Angling in on the body, it's easily nudged down to fine leg for one run.
Length delivery just around off, Tino prods forward to block but ends up getting an inside edge onto his pads.
FOUR! Swept away in style! Herath fires it full on the stumps, Masakadza gets low in the crease and sweeps it through backward square leg for a boundary to get off the mark.
Covers the line and defends it into the ground.
Skids in with the angle and outside off, blocked.
Tossed up ball outside off, Masakadza prods forward and pushes it towards covers.
Hamilton Masakadza walks in at No.3.

OUT! Bowled 'em! Rangana Herath draws first blood for the umpteenth time. Bowls a slider around off, it hits one of the cracks there and skids in as well. Chari prods forward to defend but there is a huge gap between his bat and pad as the ball goes through to take the middle stick out. Sri Lanka need 9 wickets to win!
Loopy ball around middle and leg, Tino gets back and flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Much, much better. Brilliant line as it's attacking the top of off stump, forces Chari to get right behind the line and defend.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
FOUR! Poor line and it's dispatched! Straying on the hips, Chari just whips it through backward square leg and beats the diving fielder out in the deep.
Lakmal once again getting some nice carry here. Pitches it on a length outside off, Brian lunges forward and shoulders his arms to that one.
Good shot from Brian Chari. He presents the full face of the bat and drives it back down the ground for a couple of good runs.
Back of a length delivery around off, Chari hangs back and keeps it out on the off side.
Fires it full on off, defended back to the bowler.
Full and comes in with the angle, Tino presses forward and defends with his bat close to pad, that's risky!
Gets right behind the line and blocks it out watchfully.
Tossed up ball around middle and off, Mawoyo gets back to defend but is a bit squared up as the ball goes off the outside part of the bat past sily point.
Full and fired around off, it's kept out well.
Drifts in from around off, Chari comes forward and gets it off the inner half past short leg's right for a single.
Short of a length delivery coming in on middle and leg, Mawoyo fends it away on the leg side.

This one keeps going on with the angle, maybe straightens a touch after hitting the deck, Tino Mawoyo taps it in front of covers and scampers to the other end to complete a single. There is an overthrow at the striker's end and that allows the batsmen to take another one.
Good length delivery outside off, Tino takes a big stride forward only to leave it be.
Suranga is getting some good swing here. He pitches this one right up there, just around off, Mawoyo gets it off the inner half of the bat to the on side.
Quite harmless, that. It's going away from well outside off, no trouble for the batsman to not play at it.
A bit too straight from Lakmal, angles it in on middle and leg, it's worked to square leg for no run.
Skids in after pitching, it's played with an angled bat towards point.
Flattish around middle, TM gets back and tucks it in time behind square on the leg side for a single.
Beaten! Flighted ball around middle and off, straightens a touch after pitching as Mawoyo comes forward to defend but misses as the ball goes past the outside edge to the keeper.
Gives this one a bit more air around off, Tino presses forward and defends it off the inner half of the bat past short leg.
Tossed up ball around off, Chari comes down the track and drives it towards long off for a single.
Floated ball around off, pushed off the front foot towards covers.
A shade of away movement for Suranga Lakmal as he once again bowls it around off. No shot offered by the batsman and that's the end of the over.
Maintains a good line here, Lakmal. Bowls it in the channel outside off, good shape on that too. It's left alone for Kusal Perera to collect.
Angling in sharply on middle and leg, Mawoyo is caught on the thigh pad as he attempt to flick it across the line.
Play and a miss! Good length delivery shaping away from outside off, TM looks to tap it down towards third man but fails to do so.
Some excellent carry for Lakmal here. He bowls it on a length in the channel outside off, Mawoyo leaves it alone as the keeper collects it at a good height.
Back of a length delivery just around the off stump, Tino defends it gently on the on side.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat. A maiden for Herath!
Full and around middle, Chari looks to defend but gets an inside edge on the pads.
Angles it on off, it's the arm ball, Chari brings his bat close to pad and keeps it out.
Full and around off, Brian presses forward and keeps it out.
Loopy ball around middle and off, Chari defends it down gently.
Tossed up around off, Chari prods forward and defends it in front of silly point.
Rangana Herath will share the new cherry from the other end!
Slightly fuller in length, outside off, left alone for the keeper to collect. Exciting opening over from Suranga Lakmal comes to an end.
The batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
Back of a length delivery around off, Tino rises and keeps it down on the track.
FOUR! On a good length and outside off, the ball takes the outside edge as Mawoyo hangs his bat out to this one. It races away down to third man and that will be a boundary.
Excellent! Brilliant length delivery just around off, Tino Mawaoyo fails to put any bat on ball and is beaten outside his off stump.

Why, Herath, why? Why have you not taken the review there? That looked plumb even to the blind eye. First ball of the innings, Lakmal comes steaming in and bowls a back of a length delivery on off, keeps very low as Mawoyo fails to bring his bat down in time. He is rapped on the pads and the Lankans scream for an appeal. The umpire is unmoved. Sri Lanka however decide not to take the review for some reason. Wrong call there, Rangi. Replays show it to be hitting middle and off. Should have gone for it.
